verdict.rationale: Cross-platform availability is a fair question for any terminal emulator, so the axis applies. The evidence shows iTerm2 is macOS-only: it 'works on Macs with macOS 10.14 or newer.' Community users note there is no like-for-like replacement on Windows or Linux, so there is no evidence of running the same terminal and config across all three OSes.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the same terminal with the same config on macOS, Linux, and Windows
